Citymaker.Feature.bigStatue.Tooltip: A statue scaled up to monumental size on a stepped plinth at the head of an axis, with an avenue of lamps, flags or trees leading to it.
Citymaker.Feature.folly.Tooltip: A Palace of Fine Arts style folly made of props: a rotunda of columns round a statue, a lagoon in front and colonnade walks you can stroll through.
Citymaker.Feature.obelisk.Tooltip: A tall obelisk on a stepped base in a paved court with corner pieces, benches and a low hedge ring.
Citymaker.Feature.triumphalArch.Tooltip: A gateway astride a wide walk: a triumphal arch, a pair of pylons or a screen of columns, with statues and flags.
Citymaker.Feature.sculptureWalk.Tooltip: A walk lined with sculptures on paved pads, each framed by shrubs with a bench facing it.
Citymaker.Feature.terraceGarden.Tooltip: A circle or oval of terraces with radial spokes and ring walks round a statue or fountain, with a small amphitheatre carved into one side.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.Smaller: The {0} was made smaller to fit the free space.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.ScaledDown: The {0} was scaled down to fit its space.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.NoColumns: No columns are installed: trees (or statues) stand in for them.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.NoArch: No arch is installed: a pair of pylons frames the walk instead.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.NoObelisk: No obelisk is installed: a monument or statue stands on the base instead.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.WaterNotFlat: The ground is not flat enough for real water: the pool uses a water-look surface.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.FewerSculpture: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit along the walk.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.NoRoomForCentr: There was no room for the centrepiece in the rotunda.
Citymaker.Monuments.Issue.AmphiNeedsSunk: The amphitheatre needs sunken terraces (seats look down to the stage), so it was left out.
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.Name: Big statue
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.kind.Tooltip: A single figure, a group (the main figure with two lesser ones) or a colossus (larger still, on a taller base).
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.size.Tooltip: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the statue is built. It is scaled down when the space is too small.
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.plinth.Tooltip: Raises the ground under the statue in square steps (permanent terrain change).
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.focal.Tooltip: At the far end of the axis, or in the middle with the approach on one side.
Citymaker.AddOn.BigStatue.avenue.Tooltip: What lines the approach, in matching pairs.
Citymaker.AddOn.Obelisk.Name: Obelisk
Citymaker.AddOn.Obelisk.size.Tooltip: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the obelisk is built.
Citymaker.AddOn.Obelisk.steps.Tooltip: Square steps raised in the ground under the obelisk (permanent terrain change). 0 = none.
Citymaker.AddOn.Obelisk.corners.Tooltip: Four matching pieces on the court's diagonals.
Citymaker.AddOn.Obelisk.hedgeRing.Toolti: A low hedge round the court with an opening on each axis.
Citymaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.Name: Triumphal gateway
Citymaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.kind.Toolt: A triumphal arch astride the walk, a pair of pylons framing it, or a propylaea: a screen of columns with the walk through the middle.
Citymaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.size.Toolt: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the arch, pylons or columns are built.
Citymaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.wings.Tool: Four statues on the corners of the square, facing along the walk.
Citymaker.AddOn.TriumphalArch.square.Too: Paving under and round the gateway.
Citymaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.Name: Sculpture walk
Citymaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.style.Tool: A gentle S-curve, a straight gallery or a zigzag.
Citymaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.size.Toolt: How much bigger than the assets' normal size the sculptures are built.
Citymaker.AddOn.SculptureWalk.variety.To: Each sculpture a little bigger or smaller, so the walk has rhythm.
An arc of clipped shrubs behind each sculpture.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.Name: Folly (rotunda)
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.columns.Tooltip: Columns in the rotunda's ring. Where the walk passes, the ring opens (with an arch when one is installed).
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.columnScale.Toolti: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the columns (and arches) are built.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.arches.Tooltip: Arches where the walk enters and leaves the rotunda (only when arch assets are installed).
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.arms.Tooltip: Columns on both sides of the walk curving round the lagoon from the rotunda: a colonnade you walk through.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.armSpan.Tooltip: How far round the lagoon each colonnade arm reaches from the rotunda.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.lagoon.Tooltip: An oval pool in front of the rotunda, so it is seen across the water.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.realWater.Tooltip: Digs the lagoon and fills it with water (permanent, flat ground only). Otherwise a water-look surface.
Citymaker.AddOn.Folly.planting.Tooltip: Shrubs at the ends of the lagoon and a backdrop of trees behind the rotunda.
Citymaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.Name: Terrace garden
Stepping down to the centre (sunken), up to it (a garden mount) or flat. Terraces reshape the ground permanently.
Citymaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.spokes.Too: Radial walks from the inner ring to the outer ring; one points at the entrance and runs on to it.
Citymaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.rings.Tool: Oval walks on the innermost and outermost terraces, joined to every spoke.
Citymaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.size.Toolt: How much bigger than the asset's normal size the central statue is built (fountains up to 200 %).
Citymaker.AddOn.TerraceGarden.amphitheat: Carves the side opposite the entrance into rows of seats looking down at a small stage in front of the centrepiece (sunken terraces only).
